title: 40-year-old man who smells of alcohol
arrival: A 40-year-old man smells strongly of alcohol. He comes in saying he would like to see a doctor.
feedbackWhy: He is violent and threatening other patients and staff. His behaviour poses an immediate safety risk.
reviewNote: The source case marks Circulation and Disability as “unable to assess” rather than a clean No (unsafe to approach). This prototype forces both to “No” so the yes/no walkthrough can continue, and explains the nuance in the rationale text. Confirm whether a distinct “cannot assess” answer option should be added instead.

other_red.text: Violent and aggressive. Threatening both another patient and staff.
